visible_observation: The primary exhibition title 'ECHOES of the UNSEEN' utilizes three distinct typographic treatments: 'ECHOES' and 'UNSEEN' are set in a standard serif, while 'of the' is set in an italicized serif. Additionally, the artist name 'ELARA VANCE' is styled in a widely tracked, small-caps sans-serif with a yellow tint.
critique: This typographic fragmentation violates the mandate for a restrained palette and repeatable rules. By introducing three different font weights/styles (Regular, Italic, Sans-SmallCaps) for the primary header hierarchy, the design creates visual noise rather than a cohesive identity. The italicized 'of the' acts as an arbitrary stylistic flourish that disrupts the geometric rhythm of the title block.
revision: Unify the exhibition title by applying a single typographic style (e.g., all standard serif) to 'ECHOES of the UNSEEN'. Establish hierarchy through scale and weight (e.g., Bold vs. Regular) rather than switching between italic and roman forms. Align the artist name's font family with the body text or title to reduce the total font count.
protected_strength: The high-contrast layout and the atmospheric, abstract geometric artwork on the right must remain intact, as they successfully deliver the 'immersive' and 'experimental' requirements of the brief.
